missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative predicate. 'Слово' is the nominative predicate noun. 'Важное' is the agreeing neuter adjective, intensified by 'очень'. A clean descriptive sentence.
Strategic focus: Accusative object. 'Слово' is the accusative direct object of 'знаю'; neuter inanimate nouns keep the nominative form in the accusative. 'Это' agrees with it.
Strategic focus: Genitive after negation. 'Слова' is the genitive form, common after a negated verb like 'не помню'. 'Этого' agrees in the neuter genitive.
Strategic focus: Dative after 'благодаря'. 'Слову' is dative, governed by the preposition 'благодаря'. 'Одному' agrees in the neuter dative, marking the single decisive word.
Strategic focus: Instrumental of means. 'Словом' is instrumental, the means of starting. 'Этим' agrees in the neuter instrumental, and 'начни' is the imperative.
Strategic focus: Prepositional case. 'Слове' is prepositional after 'в', the location of the stress. 'Этом' agrees in the neuter prepositional.
Strategic focus: Nominative plural subject. 'Слова' is the nominative plural subject of 'звучат'; the stress shifts in the plural. 'Эти' agrees in the plural.
Strategic focus: Genitive plural after 'много'. 'Слов' is the zero-ending genitive plural required by 'много'. 'Новых' agrees in the genitive plural, and 'выучил' is past tense.
Strategic focus: Accusative object. 'Слово' is the accusative direct object of 'скажи'; the neuter form matches the nominative. 'Доброе' agrees in the neuter accusative.
Strategic focus: Prepositional case. 'Слове' is prepositional after 'об', the topic of discussion. 'Этом' agrees in the neuter prepositional.
